limited_overlap.description: Applicants with prior earnings from 50,210 to 144,380 dollars: 225 training rows, 89% of them with estimated enrolment propensity outside 0.02-0.98. Enrolment was rare there, so the effects for these applicants rest on few enrolled rows and on model extrapolation. 14.7% of all training rows are outside the bounds.
Applicants who did not answer the follow-up survey: their earnings are not observed, and the estimates assume non-response depends only on the covariates and enrolment.

The arm-specific aipw estimate is 8,694 dollars (90% interval -334 to 17,722). The reported ATE is the pooled augmented score; the arm-specific outcome models extrapolate in the high-prior stratum.

Intervals for the ATE, ATT, subgroups and the employment effect are normal intervals of the mean of the augmented scores over the chosen rows. They describe the sampled applicants and do not add variance for the nuisance models.
